name: Claude
summary: A terminal holding the Claude Code session that belongs to this epic, these parts and this kehikko.
guidance: A person on this canvas has a Claude Code session open in a terminal, kept for exactly the epic, the picked parts and the kehikko in front of them. It is theirs: they type in it, and nothing here lets you type into it, start one or end one. Call `sessions` with the project path to see which sessions belong to which place — their first prompt, when each was last active, and whether a running one is working, waiting for its person or finished — before starting work that one of them may already hold. Placing this module on a kehikko starts nothing by itself: a place with no session asks its person which of the project’s sessions to carry on with (or a new one) when the project has any, and a session already open in another process is asked about rather than copied. Call `sessions` with `place` to be told in words what a place holds.

mcp.about: Which Claude Code sessions a person keeps for which place (epic, picked parts, kehikko), and whether a running one is working, waiting for them or finished. Read-only: starts, ends and types nothing.

settings.label: Resume conversations cut off by a restart
settings.description: A conversation a restart stopped mid-turn is started again where it was, and told what happened. Off: it waits for you.
